items.title: Ate – Portable dense memory for AI agents (.mv2 format)
items.raw_excerpt:
We built ate because AI agents keep forgetting everything between sessions. RAG retrieves documents, but agents need to remember what they learned — decisions, preferences, context. ate stores thousands of memories in a single .mv2 file (~2MB for 10K memories). It's encrypted (AES-256), works offline, and agents can carry their memory file anywhere. Key features:
- Multi-agent concurrent access (MVCC, no locks)
- Memory Capsules for sharing context between agents
- Trains of thought for reasoning chains
- Works with CrewAI, LangChain, and Agno (PRs open) Install: pip install ate-memory
Try: ate memory init my-agent && ate memory add my-agent --text "first memory" We're using it to give our own agents persistent memory. Would love feedback from anyone building multi-agent systems.

items.title: 当 AI 开始写 80% 的代码，架构才是真正的护城河

title_i18n.en: When AI writes 80% of the code, architecture becomes the true moat.
title_i18n.es: Cuando la IA comienza a escribir el 80% del código, la arquitectura se convierte en la verdadera barrera defensiva.

excerpt_i18n.zh: GitHub CEO Thomas Dohmke 近日发出了一则措辞严厉的警告：“要么拥抱 AI，要么离开这个职业。”但所谓拥抱 AI，并不只是使用代码自动补全工具那么简单。它意味着我们核心能力的一次转移——从对语法的熟练掌握，转向系统思维（Systems Thinking），学会把问题不断拆解，直到小到可以交由 AI 去解决。一句话概括：我们现在都是架构师了。
excerpt_i18n.en: GitHub CEO Thomas Dohmke recently issued a stern warning: "Embrace AI or leave the profession." However, embracing AI is not just about using code autocompletion tools. It signifies a shift in our core competencies—from mastering syntax to systems thinking, learning to break down problems until they are small enough for AI to solve. In short, we are all architects now.
excerpt_i18n.es: El CEO de GitHub, Thomas Dohmke, recientemente emitió una severa advertencia: "Adopta la IA o abandona la profesión". Pero adoptar la IA no se trata simplemente de usar herramientas de autocompletado de código. Significa un cambio en nuestras capacidades fundamentales: pasar del dominio de la sintaxis al pensamiento sistémico, aprendiendo a descomponer problemas hasta que sean lo suficientemente pequeños para que la IA los resuelva. En resumen: ahora todos somos arquitectos.

items.raw_excerpt: 在大语言模型快速迈向更强推理能力与更复杂应用场景的过程中，“上下文长度”已经从一个模型配置参数，演变为制约系统能力上限的关键瓶颈。 一方面，长文档理解、跨轮对话记忆、复杂规划与长链式推理等任务，对模型提出了远超传统 4k 或 8k 序列长度的需求；另一方面，主流 Transformer 架构中基于全注意力机制的计算模式，在序列长度增长时不可避免地带来平方级的时间与显存开销，使得“支持更长上下文”在现实工程中迅速转化为难以承受的成本问题。 围绕这一矛盾，稀疏注意力几乎成为学术界与工业界的共识方向，但随之而来的，并不是问题的彻底解决，而是一系列新的结构性张力。 过去数年中，大量工作尝试通过引入新的注意力结构、路由机制或可训练稀疏模块来缓解计算压力。这些方法在理论复杂度或特定评测上往往表现出色，但在真实模型训练与部署流程中，却逐渐暴露出一个被长期低估的问题：当前大语言模型几乎无一例外遵循“短序列预训练、长序列微调”的训练范式，而一些修改模型架构的稀疏注意力方案例如NSA，在结构、参数或输出形式上与标准 dense attention 存在显著不对齐。 正是在这一背景下，清华大学刘知远团队提出了《InfLLM-V2: Dense-Sparse Switchable Attention for Seamless Short-to-Long Adaptation》。与以往强调“引入新结构”或“增加可训练模块”的路径不同，这项研究将关注点前移至一个更基础的问题：稀疏注意力是否必须以改变模型结构为代价，才能获得长上下文效率？ 为此研究团队提出了一种 dense–sparse 可切换的注意力框架，试图在以原有 dense attention 参数作为起始点，保持输出形式不变，做到长短文本可同时训练，且能高效地实现从短上下文到长上下文的平滑过渡。 值得一提的是，这项工作并未将重点放在单一指标的

excerpt_i18n.en: In the rapid advancement of large language models toward stronger reasoning capabilities and more complex application scenarios, "context length" has evolved from a model configuration parameter into a critical bottleneck limiting the upper bound of system capabilities. On one hand, tasks such as long document comprehension, cross-turn dialogue memory, complex planning, and long-chain reasoning demand far beyond the traditional 4k or 8k sequence lengths. On the other hand, the computational pattern based on full attention mechanisms in mainstream Transformer architectures inevitably leads to quadratic increases in time and memory costs as sequence length grows, making "supporting longer contexts" quickly translate into prohibitive costs in practical engineering. Amid this contradiction, sparse attention has almost become a consensus direction in both academia and industry, yet it has not led to a complete solution but rather a series of new structural tensions. Over the past few years, numerous efforts have attempted to alleviate computational pressure by introducing new attention structures, routing mechanisms, or trainable sparse modules. While these methods often excel in theoretical complexity or specific benchmarks, they have gradually revealed a long-underestimated issue in real-world model training and deployment workflows: current large language models almost universally follow the training paradigm of "short-sequence pre-training, long-sequence fine-tuning," and some sparse attention solutions that modify model architecture, such as NSA, exhibit significant misalignment with standard dense attention in structure, parameters, or output format. excerpt_i18n.es: En el rápido avance de los grandes modelos de lenguaje hacia capacidades de razonamiento más potentes y escenarios de aplicación más complejos, la "longitud de contexto" ha evolucionado de un parámetro de configuración del modelo a un cuello de botella clave que limita el potencial del sistema. Por un lado, tareas como la comprensión de documentos extensos, la memoria en conversaciones multirronda, la planificación compleja y el razonamiento en cadena larga exigen del modelo necesidades que superan con creces las longitudes de secuencia tradicionales de 4k u 8k. Por otro lado, el patrón computacional basado en el mecanismo de atención completa en la arquitectura Transformer predominante, inevitablemente genera un costo cuadrático en tiempo y memoria de video a medida que aumenta la longitud de la secuencia, convirtiendo el "soporte de contextos más largos" en un problema de costos insostenible en la ingeniería práctica.
